records.title: The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 2008
details: Supplementaries raised by the Members about the list of the names of the product for the geographical indications, idea about the plant for the north-eastern producers, to consider for including two varieties of rice i.e. Joha rice and Komal rice in the second schedule. The Minister inter alia replied that the necessary amendments may be carried out.

records.title: Damage to crops due to pests and other diseases
details: Supplementary by Member regarding the efficacy of BT Cotton it was stated that it has been found that one of the reasons for complaints against BT cotton is proper seeds was not given to the farmers . The matter is being enquired into and appropriate against those found reksponsible for misleading the farmers.

records.title: Short duration discussion on State of Agriuclture, Poverty and Unemployment in the country in the light of Mid-term appraisal of Tenth Five Year Plan
details: To a supplementary regarding the action going to be taken on the 1st two Committees constituted to look into the matter of restructuring of ICAR , it was stated that the General Body Meeting has been called to take final decision in the matter.

records.title: Safeguarding interests of Indian IT companies
Role of sports Associations
details: Supplementary by Member regarding whether the Ministry would do anything about grabbing of sports authority by politicians , it was stated that a list would be present to the House showing the number of politicians and bureaucrates in thie sport authority posts and also their tenure.

records.title: Point raised on 6-12-2004 during the discussion on the motion for consideration of the Banking REgulation(Amendment) and Miscellaneous Provision Bill, 2004.
details: To a query whether RBI will have an overriding authority on regulation of multistate cooperative banks or whether there is still room for having dual authority on the part of RBI and the STate Governemnt , it was stated that the RBI is expected to finalise its recommendations in the next few weeks and I will bring a comprehensive amending Bill in the Budget session of the Parliament to amend the Banking REgulation Act.

records.title: Assessment of capacity of plants to absorb carbon dioxide.
Director benefit transfer in fertilizer sector
details: The Government has constituted a Committee being monitored by the NITI Aayog, which is yet to give its report. Once this first phase is completed, the second phase will be taken up post recommendations of the Committee that has been set up by the NITI Aayog.

records.title: Smuggling of red sanders
details: The Government has not maintained any record in this regard. However, in pursuance to the guidelines issued by the National Human Rights Commission, every case of death during the course of Police action is to be reported to the National Human Rights Commission within 48 hours of its occurrence.

records.title: Banned medicines
details: Supplementary by Member regarding setting up of a strong national regulatory authorities for drug testing drug quality control and drug standards like the FDA it was stated that a Govenrment is thinking in term of and independent authorities and the matter is being looked into.
